bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for energy efficiency improvements to the former St. Paul Athletic Club building.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ST. PAUL ATHLETIC CLUB.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $4,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Youthprise for energy efficiency improvements to the former St. Paul Athletic Club building. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.

(b) For the purposes of this section, energy efficiency improvements include roof repair and replacement to support solar panels, LED lighting improvements, and design and engineering costs.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $4,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Youthprise for energy efficiency improvements to the former St. Paul Athletic Club building. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
(b) For the purposes of this section, energy efficiency improvements include roof repair and replacement to support solar panels, LED lighting improvements, and design and engineering costs.
